create_colbert_encoder: create a ColBERTEncoder instance from a pretrained model path with configurable dropout and projection dimensions
run_colbert_forward: run the ColBERTEncoder forward pass on tokenized inputs to get expert representations with attention masking
build_colbert_with_projection: build a ColBERTEncoder with a custom projection dimension to reduce hidden state embeddings

summarize_colbert_forward_output: summarize the ColBERTEncoder forward method that returns masked expert representations from the last hidden state
